The '''Dithanune system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Bortele sector/Legends|Bortele sector]], in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dithanune]].
